description: Research r16 (dev only, H100): r5 a01_fp32_lr1e-6_skip_cos_mal0 (A 001 + fp32 master weights at lr 1e-6, zero-advantage rows skipped, training reward 0 for truncated outputs) with the cosine to 0.1x counted over 500 steps (budget_steps 500, no time stop), on r5's H100 settings. It follows r14 seed 0's lr path by step (4.1e-7 at step 300, 2.9e-7 at 350, 1.9e-7 at 400), without TIS's 2.2x slower sampling: r14 seed 0 (r5 + TIS cap 2) ended at dev 0.398 (best 0.410) where r5's three seeds collapsed at steps 375-525 at lr 3.2-5.3e-7, but its cap clipped ~1e-5 of tokens and its slow steps had annealed the time-based lr. Same recipe as calibration/research_r15/mal0_st500 on box 1; this H100 seed compares with r5's and r14's H100 seeds.
